title: plan-review finding
description: One finding returned by a Phase 2 review-lens agent. Reviewers return an array of these.

id.description: Stable id within this lens, e.g. F1

lens.description: Which review lens produced this finding

kind.description: gap = missing & needed; improvement = better-with; error = code contradicts the plan

severity.description: Anchored to consequence, not to confidence

artifact_evidence.description: Verbatim quote from the artifact (what it says or fails to say), with a section pointer

code_evidence.description: file:line from the repo that grounds the finding, with a note. Empty if not grounded.

status_color.description: Gap-register color: 🟢 OOTB · 🔵 Config · 🟡 Custom Dev · 🔴 Gap · ⚪ TBD · 🟣 3rd Party

confidence.description: How sure the reviewer is. Low-confidence + high-consequence => report as open question, not blocker.
